gc.basisessen.title: Less hunger at base (mod)
gc.basisessen.short: Food runs out more slowly at a workbench and inside a ward.
gc.basisessen.body:
The mod brings [[gc.basisessen.basefood|less hunger at base]]: within range of a workbench or an active ward your food lasts longer. It belongs to the **ValheimPlusPlus** package ([[gc.kern.stufe|level]] 4 “GC light”); the server and all players need it, and all its values are [[gc.serverrules|server rules]].

Because it makes the game easier, it adds a compensation of 1 % per defeated boss to the [[gc.kern.bossscale|boss progression]] while it is switched on; the highest value of all running mods counts.

gc.basisessen.basefood.title: Less hunger at base
gc.basisessen.basefood.short: Food lasts longer within range of a workbench or an active ward.
gc.basisessen.basefood.body:
Within the build radius of a [[valheim.station.workbench|workbench]] your hunger loss drops by {gc_basisessen_basefood_workbench}, so your [[valheim.food.food|food]] lasts longer; inside an active ward it drops by {gc_basisessen_basefood_ward}. 100 % means no hunger loss at all, and if you stand in both areas, the larger value counts.

By default only the workbench counts as a station, and only wards you have [[gc.basisessen.basefood_access|access]] to. Other mods that change food duration, such as ValheimPlus, keep working; the saving comes on top.

gc.basisessen.basefood_access.title: Only wards with access
gc.basisessen.basefood_access.short: Only your own or permitted wards reduce hunger.
gc.basisessen.basefood_access.body: On: only an active ward you have access to counts, meaning your own or one you are permitted on. Off: every active ward counts, also someone else's. The setting is a [[gc.serverrules|server rule]].
